description.value: A 24/7 McDonald's location at Mt. Lehman Crossing in Abbotsford, opened in late 2023. It offers Drive-Thru, Curbside, and McDelivery service, making it a convenient all-hours stop for cyclists on Fraser Highway. Free Wi-Fi and onsite washrooms add practical value for those on longer tours.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wave (3 spaces) at 28m; wave (3 spaces) at 66m. Total: 6 spaces.

The website confirms the location page at the exact URL tagged in OSM and shows the address 'ABBOTSFORD, 30720 Fraser Highway', matching OSM. OSM tags provide toilets=yes, takeaway=yes, internet_access=wlan with internet_access:fee=no (free Wi-Fi); the website confirms Drive-Thru and Curbside takeout services but does not mention bike parking, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities beyond what OSM states.
